about: Leader rules read by engine.py, and by the servers from each turn's manifest copy. A leader marshals the people of their segment toward some purpose; the player is their nation's root leader. A leader's type is its internal name; 'title' is what a leader of that type is called unless their player chose another (founding a kingdom lets them). Each type lists the 'commands' its leaders can be given (orders.py), the 'activity' their segment feeds itself by (engine.py's schedules; 'subsistence' is hunting and gathering, 'farming' is farming and herding) and whether it is 'settled': a settled segment stays where it is, and keeps other nations from settling on its tile. start_type is the type of every leader at turn 0. 'commands' below sets what the commands that change a leader's type do.

chieftain.about: Leads a band; the player starts as their nation's chieftain.
chieftain.title: Chieftain

mayor.about: Leads a settled town or city.
mayor.title: Mayor

king.about: Leads a nation from a settled kingdom, whose people farm and herd.
king.title: King

found_kingdom.about: The leader's segment settles on its tile, which it must be wholly on (not between two tiles), and the leader becomes 'becomes', under the title their player gives (default_title if none, at most max_title_length characters). A tile where another nation already has a settled segment can't be settled; if leaders of two or more nations found kingdoms on the same tile in the same turn, none of them does. The segment farms from the year the order resolves.
